title: Provider fidelity claims
description: Claims a pack makes about how faithfully it models a provider API (specification section 48.7). Every claim names its evidence class and its source; documentation review is never live behavioral verification.

provider.description: The provider API the pack models.

api_version.description: Pinned provider API version, for example 2026-03-10.

base_url.description: Provider base URL the claims were read from.

claims.description: One claim per modeled behavior; ids stay stable across pack versions.

classification.description: documented: the provider documents it. observed: a recorded live run verified it. synthetic: the emulator provides it without a provider guarantee. unsupported: outside the modeled surface.

operations.description: Operation keys the claim covers; the corpus case or assertion references below name the checks.

references.description: Case ids, assertion ids, or claim text anchors this claim backs.

source_url.description: Where the claim was read from. Synthetic claims cite the pack's own corpus.

provider_version.description: Provider API version the source described, when it differs from the pin.

last_verified_at.description: Date a live run last verified the claim; absent means never.

report_digest.description: SHA-256 of the verification report that observed the claim.

limitations.description: What the claim does not cover.
